schema:
CREATE TABLE budget (
  amount,
  budget_id,
  category,
  event_status,
  link_to_event,
  remaining,
  spent
);

CREATE TABLE event (
  event_date,
  event_id,
  event_name,
  location,
  notes,
  status,
  type
);

CREATE TABLE expense (
  approved,
  cost,
  expense_date,
  expense_description,
  expense_id,
  link_to_budget,
  link_to_member
);

CREATE TABLE income (
  amount,
  date_received,
  income_id,
  link_to_member,
  notes,
  source
);

CREATE TABLE member (
  email,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  link_to_major,
  member_id,
  phone,
  position,
  t_shirt_size,
  zip
);

CREATE TABLE zip_code (
  city,
  county,
  short_state,
  state,
  type,
  zip_code
);
